chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 13: The Art of Alchemy — A Life in Exchange for a Pill
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns alchemy, but his first success forces a terrible choice: save one life by sending another to the furnace. A turning point in survival and morality.
og_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 13: The Art of Alchemy
og_description: Li Huowang uses a Daoist taboo to save Bai Lingmiao, only to be forced to personally deliver another man to be ground into medicine. A cold lesson in the cost of survival.
twitter_title: The moment you save a life by learning how to send another to die. Ch. 13 of Dao Gui Yi Xian hits hard.
twitter_description: Li Huowang learns alchemy the hard way: one pill costs one life. A chilling chapter about knowledge, sacrifice, and the weight of following orders.
